summary: Use QGIS and Excel to assess property data, compare sites and present spatial evidence. Explore the five-day real estate analysis course.
lede: Real estate analytics and GIS help analysts, valuers and investment teams connect transaction, parcel and location evidence to property decisions. With QGIS and Excel, learners check data quality, select comparable properties, assess proximity and network access, and prepare maps and briefings that make assumptions and evidence limits clear.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who already work with property information and need to connect transaction, parcel and location evidence to real estate decisions.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with real estate transactions or property records and spreadsheet analysis is expected. No coding or programming is required. You should be comfortable reviewing tables and interpreting basic maps.
